Lando Norris believes Kimi Antonelli has done an "incredible job" and performed "two levels above" Mercedes team-mate George Russell this season, in form which has taken the Italian to the brink of a record-breaking world championship triumph. Antonelli looks all but assured to succeed Norris as F1's reigning world champion this year thanks to the 102-point lead he holds at the top of the standings with six races left. metadata.summary: Lewis Hamilton has explained the reasons why he overrode Ferrari's call to pit in the Singapore Grand Prix, a mistake he says he "owned up to" and will work not to repeat - but which would not prevent him from continuing "challenging the norms".
metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver explains taking strategy into own hands in Singapore ahead of United States GP | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver explains taking strategy into own hands in Singapore ahead of United States GP Ferrari driver speaks in person for the first time about why he opted not to pit for a second time in the Singapore GP despite being asked to; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, starting with first practice at 6pm on Friday evening Friday 23 October 2026 00:37, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lewis Hamilton gives an insight into his costly decision to override Ferrari's strategy call in Singapore. Lewis Hamilton has explained the reasons why he overrode Ferrari's call to pit in the Singapore Grand Prix, a mistake he says he "owned up to" and will work not to repeat - but which would not prevent him from continuing "challenging the norms". Hamilton dropped out of the podium positions to sixth on worn tyres in the closing stages of the last race at Marina Bay after what proved the costly decision not to pit under the Virtual Safety Car, as the Ferrari pit wall had requested. Feeling unwell after the gruelling night race, and being excused from his post-race media obligations by the FIA, Hamilton's only comments about his race came via a statement issued by the team and then a post on his Instagram account, in which he said he took responsibility for the strategy
